title: Certificates of Deposit: Testing a Renewed Term for the Jumbo Bonus
content:
Each renewed term of Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit is tested afresh for the Jumbo Bonus. This page states the test and the figure it is run on.

## The test

A renewed term earns the Jumbo Bonus when both of these are true:

1. the tier offers the Jumbo Bonus; and
2. the certificate's principal, read from its own ledger as that ledger stands when the renewal is booked, is at least the tier's Jumbo Bonus threshold.

The Jumbo Bonus marker recorded for the new term states the outcome of this test: set when the Jumbo Bonus is earned, not set when it is not.

## The figure tested

The figure tested is always the ledger-built principal at the moment of booking, never simply the balance shown on the certificate record. Where the two disagree, the ledger-built figure decides the test. The renewal date itself stays the old maturity date; only the reading of the ledger belongs to the moment of booking.

The same ledger-built figure is used for every renewal: a renewal into the certificate's own tier, a renewal into another tier elected by the owner in grace, and one the owner books while grace is running.

## Condition, judgement, outcome (hypothetical; Jumbo Bonus threshold assumed at USD 80000.00 purely for illustration)

| Tier offers the Jumbo Bonus | Ledger-built principal | Balance shown on the record | Jumbo Bonus earned? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | USD 80000.00 | USD 80000.00 | Yes; at the threshold counts |
| Yes | USD 79999.99 | USD 81000.00 | No; the ledger-built figure decides |
| Yes | USD 80150.00 | USD 79900.00 | Yes; the ledger-built figure decides |
| No | USD 250000.00 | USD 250000.00 | No; the tier does not offer it |

## Point of judgement

**The owner renews during grace into a different tier.** The test is still run on the ledger-built principal read when that renewal is booked, exactly as for any other renewal.
